result.summary: Found 2 issues: a critical data display error and a major text truncation problem.

issues.description: Smash Bros Burgers shows '€NaN delivery' instead of a valid delivery fee. NaN (Not a Number) indicates a data loading or calculation error.
issues.suggestion: Fix the backend logic that calculates delivery fees. Implement error handling to display a default value (e.g., '€0 delivery' or a loading state) if the delivery fee cannot be calculated.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated and doesn't display the full name (likely 'Trattoria Piccolo'). Users cannot see complete restaurant information.
issues.suggestion: Either increase the available space for restaurant names, use text ellipsis properly with a full name tooltip, or adjust the card layout to accommodate longer names.
